messages:
Marta: Quick ask — we need a concise 1‑pager + webinar narrative that clearly positions Redwood Private vs Dedicated for enterprise security buyers. Focus: SLAs, data residency, KMS/HSM, audit trails, and graceful degradation. Can someone own the skeleton by EOD Wed?
Ben: I can handle the technical bullets and SLA language. Will include fallback behavior and version pinning notes. Need confirmation on commit tiers for Dedicated.
Ashwin: AE view — please add a short decision flow: when to choose Private vs Dedicated + top procurement questions (PO, SOC2, encryption at rest). I'll draft 3 buyer personas (CISO, Platform Lead, Procurement).
Lee (Design): I’ll take layout and hero art. Want this to be a one‑page PDF + 1 field slide. Any strict brand constraints? Prefer short copy blocks and a clear CTA.
Nora: I’ll write two headline variants and 3 webinar invite subject lines — aiming for enterprise/security tone.
Sam (DemandGen): Suggest we tie the webinar to a benchmark narrative: p50/p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens, and a short case about graceful fallback to hosted to preserve availability. Also recommend inbound routing rules by industry/region.
Marta: Routing idea: 1) EMEA security/regulatory inquiries -> enterprise@ + assigned AM, 2) FinServ/healthcare -> dedicated AE queue, 3) Low touch/POC interest -> self‑serve trials team. Thoughts? @eng-sre can double-check SLA phrasings.
Ben: Draft SLA numbers for copy: Dedicated: 99.95% uptime SLA; Private (customer‑managed) default: available enterprise support + optional SLA 99.9%; Hosted: standard availability statement. Will confirm precise wording with eng-sre.
Ashwin: Add procurement play: short PO wording + SOW checklist (installation window, data handling, KMS integration steps). I'll sketch a sample clause.
Design-bot: Uploaded hero options: https://storage.redwood/briefs/enterprise-defense-hero-v1.png :white_check_mark: — thumbnails in the thread.
Lee: Quick UX Q — do we want a tiny benchmark table in the one‑pager (3 rows) or a separate slide? If inline, keep to 3 points: latency, cost, failover behavior.
Sam: I’ll prepare the micro‑benchmark story and the numbers (p50/p95 + cost delta) — need 48h to pull validated datapoints from the last Dedicated runs and a Hosted fallthrough test.
Marta: Plan: Ben + Ashwin + Nora to deliver copy draft by Wed noon, Lee to layout by Thu, Sam to provide benchmark by Fri, and I’ll own the webinar script. I’ll also prepare inbound routing rules for SDRs. Tagging everyone: please flag blockers. :pushpin:
Ben: noted — will ping eng-sre for final SLA wording.
Ashwin: LGTM, will draft procurement checklist tonight.
Nora: Starting subject lines: 'Secure inference at scale — Private vs Dedicated', 'Meeting enterprise SLAs without heavy ops', 'Private deployments: compliance, control, confidence' — will iterate.
Lee: Once copy is in, I’ll mock two layout options and post PDFs for review.
Marta: Thanks all — adding milestones to the calendar and creating a quick Figma board for comments. :calendar:
